hypotheses.mechanism: Existing G9 generic records/rules, Delta/ViewDelta/GraphDelta and capability separation can encode a reader-visible semantic publication barrier over committed UnifiedDB state and derived ClayGraph projection without a dedicated transaction keyword.
hypotheses.expected: Mismatch, incomplete projection/retraction, crash-before-publish and graph-only authority cases are rejected without exposing mixed CURRENT state.
hypotheses.observed: 12/12 fixed cases and 20000 mutation rounds passed; no mixed-epoch or graph-authority violation.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A production type/effect checker or physically split store deployment will expose semantic states that generic records/rules cannot validate without a first-class transaction/publication primitive.
hypotheses.falsifier: Production ClayCode lowering or H1/H2 crash/replay differential shows an unrepresentable or uncheckable partial-publication state despite the standard receipt contract.
hypotheses.next_test: Freeze SemanticPublicationReceipt in canonical IR, compile it with the real BASE checker/runtime, then run crash injection across separate physical state/graph stores.

hypotheses.mechanism: A new first-class transaction/publish syntax primitive is required for correctness.
hypotheses.expected: Run-local generic record/rule encoding fails at least one closure/crash/authority property.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A standard library/IR contract plus deterministic runtime commit gateway is sufficient.
hypotheses.falsifier: Real compiler cannot statically enforce the required receipt/authority/epoch constraints without opaque host-only logic.
